claims.claim: Apple's worldwide smartphone shipment share was 22% in the third quarter of 2026, a third-quarter record, despite a decline in its own iPhone shipments, according to preliminary Counterpoint figures.
claims.episode_span: Apple's share of worldwide smartphone shipments at 22% in the third quarter of 2026
claims.source_title: iPhone Takes Bigger Slice of a Shrinking Smartphone Market
claims.supporting_quote: Apple's share of worldwide smartphone shipments rose to a third-quarter record of 22% in the third quarter of 2026, despite a decline in its own iPhone shipments, according to preliminary figures from Counterpoint Research.

claims.claim: Samsung accounted for 23% of third-quarter smartphone shipments, and the industry shipped 20% fewer smartphones than a year earlier, the lowest July-to-September total since 2012.
claims.episode_span: Samsung accounted for 23%. Manufacturers shipped 20% fewer smartphones
claims.source_title: iPhone Takes Bigger Slice of a Shrinking Smartphone Market
claims.supporting_quote: Across the industry, manufacturers shipped 20% fewer smartphones than a year earlier, taking the July-to-September total to its lowest level since 2012.

claims.claim: Counterpoint said the absence of a standard iPhone 18 beside the Pro models in September meant Apple supplied fewer new devices to retail than at the iPhone 17 launch, while the iPhone 18 Pro debut was better than the prior Pro generation, with China and India standing out.
claims.episode_span: no standard iPhone 18 beside the Pro models in September
claims.source_title: iPhone Takes Bigger Slice of a Shrinking Smartphone Market
claims.supporting_quote: With no standard iPhone 18 arriving alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models in September, Counterpoint said Apple supplied fewer new devices to retail channels than during last year's iPhone 17 lineup launch.

claims.claim: Counterpoint estimates smartphone retail prices have risen 20% globally so far this year and links the downturn to memory-chip shortages and rising prices.
claims.episode_span: smartphone retail prices have risen 20% globally so far this year
claims.source_title: iPhone Takes Bigger Slice of a Shrinking Smartphone Market
claims.supporting_quote: It estimates that smartphone retail prices have risen 20% globally so far this year, with demand for premium smartphones proving to be more resilient than budget devices.
